title: Hotels Near Ramathibodi Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 8 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 8 closest hotels to Ramathibodi Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Ramathibodi, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 8 closest stays to Ramathibodi, with real distances and prices.
intro: Ramathibodi is a large public teaching hospital on Rama VI Road, with its main entrance right on the street; it's about an 11-minute walk (just over 800 m) from BTS Phaya Thai to the wards. The surrounding area covers Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi and Victory Monument, and the accommodation runs the full range — from a few-hundred-baht hostel to a five-star hotel connected to the BTS. The big plus here is onward transport: the Airport Rail Link from Phaya Thai runs straight to Suvarnabhumi, and there's food all around Victory Monument. The list below goes cheapest to priciest.

blocks.html: Short answer: Ramathibodi sits on Rama VI Road near BTS Phaya Thai, the Airport Rail Link Phaya Thai stop and Victory Monument. The places you can actually walk to the wards (about 900 m–1.2 km) cluster along the Rama VI and Si Ayutthaya side. If you're a patient's family on a budget, look at Greenery Hostel or Bangkok Oasis; for a hotel with a pool and parking, go for Bangkok Midtown; Eastin Grand and Pullman are the upscale picks, a 10-minute drive away.

blocks.text: Hotels near Ramathibodi, by distance & budget

items.name: Greenery Hostel
items.meta: 📍 7-min drive (1.2 km) · ~16-min walk to Ramathibodi · ★ 2-star · Best for: Patient families · tightest budget · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hostel on Soi Petchburi 3 in the Phaya Thai area, with private rooms that have air-con and an en-suite bathroom from a few hundred baht. It's about a 10-minute walk to BTS Ratchathewi or Phaya Thai. Reviews rate it highly for cleanliness and helpful staff, and there's free water, snacks and instant noodles all day. Good for a patient's family on a budget who don't mind a short ride to the hospital.

items.name: True Siam Phayathai Hotel
items.meta: 📍 14-min walk (1.1 km) to Ramathibodi · ★ 3-star · Best for: Near Airport Rail Link · walkable · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 65-room boutique hotel on Soi Sri-Ayutthaya 12 (Lert Panya) in Ratchathewi, set in a quiet lane close to both Phayathai and Ramathibodi hospitals. It's about a 4-minute walk to the Airport Rail Link Phaya Thai and BTS Victory Monument. Rooms are modern, there's an on-site restaurant, and reviews are strong on location and cleanliness. Handy if you're flying in and connecting via the Airport Rail Link to be near a patient.

items.name: Bangkok Midtown Hotel
items.meta: 📍 14-min walk (1.1 km) · 6-min drive to Ramathibodi · ★ 4-star · Best for: Want a pool + free parking · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A roughly 158-room hotel at 888 Rama VI Road — the same street as the hospital — with an outdoor pool and free parking. It's surrounded by rice-and-curry shops and 7-Elevens. Booking reviews give it 8.1 for location and 8.2 for staff. It works well if you're driving and travelling as a group: the free parking and pool both help, and the walk to Ramathibodi is easy on a good day.

items.name: Bangkok Oasis Hotel
items.meta: 📍 12-min walk (900 m) to Ramathibodi · ★ 3-star · Best for: Short walk · quiet lane · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small 17-room hotel on Rama VI Soi 24 in the Thung Phaya Thai area, tucked into a quiet, leafy lane with a garden. It's about 900 m — a 12-minute walk — from Ramathibodi, and roughly 5–10 minutes on foot to BTS / Airport Rail Link Phaya Thai. Rooms are spacious and clean, and reviews praise the value and friendly staff. A good pick if you want somewhere calm and can walk to the hospital without a ride.

items.name: Hi Sotel Victory Monument
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (1.8 km) to Ramathibodi · ★ 3-star · Best for: New hotel · free station pickup · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 44-room hotel that opened in 2022, on Soi Ratchawithi 18 near Victory Monument; it's on the Rajavithi Hospital side (about 460 m away), with Ramathibodi roughly a 1.8 km drive. It offers free train-station pickup and free parking. Agoda reviews are very high on the new, clean rooms. A good option if you want a brand-new room around Victory Monument with a short hop to Ramathibodi.

items.name: The Sukosol
items.meta: 📍 14-min walk (1.1 km) · 6-min drive to Ramathibodi · ★ 4-star · Best for: By Phaya Thai station · Airport Link drop-off · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A large, classic hotel at 477 Si Ayutthaya Road, about 350 m from BTS / Airport Rail Link Phaya Thai, with a free shuttle to the Airport Rail Link station. It has a pool, several restaurants and roomy units, and reviews praise the polished old-school service. A solid choice if you want a proper hotel right by the station, with a short walk or ride to Ramathibodi.

items.name: Pullman Bangkok King Power
items.meta: 📍 8-min drive (2 km) to Ramathibodi · ★ 5-star · Best for: 5-star · calm garden setting · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A five-star hotel at 8/2 Rangnam Road in the Victory Monument area, with a large garden, pool, spa and several restaurants. It's about 2 km — an 8-minute drive — from Ramathibodi, and roughly a 5-minute walk from BTS Victory Monument (exit 2). A good fit if you're here for medical reasons but want to unwind in a quiet upscale hotel and take a car to the hospital as needed.

items.name: Eastin Grand Hotel Phayathai
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (1.2 km) · ~15-min walk to Ramathibodi · ★ 5-star · Best for: On BTS Phaya Thai · most upmarket nearby · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A five-star hotel on Phaya Thai Road (The Unicorn building, no. 18) with a direct link into BTS Phaya Thai station and about a 5-minute walk to the Airport Rail Link Phaya Thai. It has a pool, a gym and high-floor restaurants. Ramathibodi is about 1.2 km — a 6-minute drive — away. The most upmarket choice in the area, with easy airport access and a short ride to the hospital.

faq.q: Can I really walk from these hotels to the Ramathibodi wards?
faq.a: From several of them, yes. Ramathibodi's main entrance is on Rama VI Road, and places along Rama VI and Si Ayutthaya — Bangkok Oasis (about 900 m), Bangkok Midtown, True Siam and The Sukosol — are roughly a 12–16 minute walk. Hi Sotel and Pullman over by Victory Monument, and Eastin Grand on BTS Phaya Thai, are easier with a short ride. Ramathibodi is a large multi-building campus, so check which building you need — walking inside can add several minutes.

faq.q: Flying into Suvarnabhumi — what's the easiest way to reach Ramathibodi?
faq.a: Take the Airport Rail Link (City Line) from Suvarnabhumi to its terminus at Phaya Thai station — about 30 minutes for roughly 35 baht. From Phaya Thai it's a few minutes on foot or by taxi / motorbike taxi to Ramathibodi. Hotels like The Sukosol, True Siam and Eastin Grand are very close to Phaya Thai station, so you can wheel a suitcase right over. Ideal if you're coming from elsewhere in Thailand or abroad for treatment.

faq.q: Are there cheap, clean places near Ramathibodi?
faq.a: Yes. For the lowest price, private rooms at Greenery Hostel start around a few hundred baht — clean and well reviewed, about a 10-minute walk to BTS Ratchathewi / Phaya Thai. True Siam and Bangkok Midtown sit around 1,000–1,500 baht and give you a full hotel room within walking distance of Ramathibodi. Rooms fill quickly when many families are visiting patients, so book ahead on Agoda, Booking or Trip.com.
